consequence.statement: UI feature addition: repo filtering while typing; no operational consequence stated.

original.statement: The UI gains support for filtering repositories as the user types input; no operational impact is stated.

decision.reason: [ev-94fd89815781] lists this only as a UI feature in the Features section of the changelog: support for filtering repos while the user types. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. It also doesn't describe a changed default or a deprecation. "none" (informational) fits an additive UI capability. Confidence is low because the evidence is a single commit title that states no consequence explicitly.
